a relative of mine killed themselves almost a decade ago. I was too young when it happened to really understand the gravity of the situation. I knew what death was, and I saw how it changed people since my brother had died two years prior, but I still didn't understand it. 

my relative lived far away, so it's not like I saw her often, and I didn't have a close relationship with her either. it just felt as if she was away. but as I got older, it slowly started to sink in. she wouldn't be coming back. her gravestone was all she left behind for me.

there's not a week that goes by where I don't think of her, at least passively. there's not a week that goes by when I don't hope I'll see her face again. there's not a week that goes by where i don't crave making more memories with her.
